我的 SDXL 模型的工作流程 雷神锤

推荐设置：针对模型

该模型不需要闪电Lora

dpmpp_sde或 Euler a / Euler 至少 3-4 步骤 / 推荐 8-9 步骤 cfg 2-2.5 / sgm_ 统一调度器，也dpmpp_3m_sde_gpu至少 10 步运行良好将提供 xyz 网格。我会将图片放入工作流程文件中

顺便说一句，该模型还可以与其他采样器一起使用，并且更高的步数最多可达 50 步（dpmpp_sde）并测试到 7 cfg，但这只是实验性的，取决于您；-）

Workflow for my SDXL Model Mjölnir

Recommended settings: for the model

The model don't need the lightning Lora

dpmpp_sdeor Euler a / Euler at least 3-4 steps / recommended 8-9 steps cfg 2-2.5 / sgm_ uniform scheduler, alsodpmpp_3m_sde_gpuruns fine on at least 10 steps will provide an xyz grid . i will place the pictures in the workflow file

btw the model works also with other samplers and higher step counts up to 50 steps (dpmpp_sde) and tested till 7 cfg but this is experimental and up to you ;-)
